description: Global cryptocurrency market overview. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "total crypto market cap", "bitcoin dominance", "state of the crypto market". Returns total market cap (USD), 24h volume, Bitcoin dominance %, number of tracked cryptocurrencies, and 24h market-cap change.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own CoinPaprika Pro API key for a dedicated quota (uses the api-pro endpoint). Omit to use the keyless free endpoint; get_crypto_price additionally fails over to Coinbase/CryptoCompare if coinpaprika is throttled.

name: get_crypto_global
title: Get Crypto Global
